info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Amazon FSx API (2018-03-01). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. FSx for Lustre file systems and Amazon File Cache resources are configuration records that stay CREATING: no file server, network interface, DNS name, mount name or storage exists and no data is read or written. Windows File Server, ONTAP and OpenZFS file systems are refused because they need Active Directory credentials, administrator passwords or volumes the simulator does not provide. Data repository links (ImportPath, ExportPath, AutoImportPolicy, data repository associations and tasks), backups, final backups on deletion, snapshots, storage virtual machines, volumes and aliases are not implemented; their APIs return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. SecurityGroupIds are refused because no network interface is created. Exactly one subnet ID is accepted, StorageCapacity is required for file systems and Lustre deployments default to SCRATCH_1. UpdateFileSystem and UpdateFileCache are not implemented because they merge nested configuration. Client tokens on deletions are accepted without replaying earlier responses.
